• Team Management & Stakeholder Coordination: Lead and support a team of two finance administrators while coordinating with external service providers and stakeholders responsible for the financial administration of international entities.

Our client is a fast-growing organization active in the financial services sector. As a Business Analyst, you will play a key role in the group's digital transformation journey. • Gather and challenge business requirements from key stakeholders.
• Act as the bridge between end-users, operational teams, and digital experts.
• Support the implementation and adoption of new digital solutions.
• Drive change management and promote best practices across the organization.
• Help users leverage new technologies and AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude.

• Knowledge of accounting and financial workflows.
• Familiarity with accounting software or digital finance solutions is a strong advantage.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Curious about technology, AI, and innovation.
• Hands-on mindset and willingness to work in a fast-growing environment.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.Key ResponsibilitiesGovernance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.
Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.
Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.
HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.
Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.
External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

ProfileWe are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - Commercial & Consumer Law - Limburg
jobs.description:

• Provide pragmatic and business-oriented legal advice to senior management and operational teams.
• Draft, review, negotiate, and manage a variety of commercial contracts.
• Advise on agency, distribution, procurement, and service agreements.
• Support construction and real estate projects, including related contractual negotiations.
• Monitor and advise on consumer law matters impacting the Belgian business.
• Contribute to ESG-related projects and provide legal support regarding evolving sustainability regulations.
• Identify legal risks and develop practical mitigation strategies.
• Strengthen compliance frameworks and internal governance procedures.
• Collaborate closely with departments such as Procurement, Marketing, Communications, and Operations.
• Translate complex legal concepts into pragmatic solutions that facilitate business growth.

A successful Legal Counsel should have:

• Master's degree in Law obtained from a Belgian university.
• Minimum 3 years of relevant legal experience as legal counsel or lawyer
• Fluent in English, ideally in Dutch as well (or conversational level)
• Strong expertise in: Commercial contracts, Consumer law, Real estate and construction law
• Exposure to ESG-related matters is considered a strong asset.
• Comfortable working independently and managing a broad legal scope.
